part.text:
Fixed. In `remove` (tokio-util/src/time/delay_queue.rs:708-719), when removing the last item makes the queue empty, the registered waker is now woken so a concurrently pending `poll_expired` re-polls and returns `Poll::Ready(None)`. `try_remove` is covered since it delegates to `remove`.

Validation: `wake_after_remove_last` and all 32 other tests in `time_delay_queue.rs` pass, all delay_queue doc tests pass, and the only failing tests (`panic.rs` location assertions) fail identically on the unmodified baseline — a pre-existing environment issue.
